text:
Anya Patel: Heads up — vendor told us today that H200 slot delivery is slipping by ~3 weeks. We need to sequence announcements so we don't promise slots we can't fill. Quick brainstorm?

Mike Chen: Ack. Do we have a mapping of press windows -> SKU availability? I can pull marketplace calendar.

Anya Patel: Not a clean one. Sofia, you own the comms calendar — can you highlight any immovable press dates?

Sofia Romero: Yep — two press windows locked: 2026-05-12 and 2026-06-02. Both are firm. We can shift internal announcements, but partners expect at least a soft ETA.

Li Zhang: Technical constraint: H200 requires microcode v2.3 and a driver kernel patch that vendors are still validating. If we push GA before that, we need fallback routing to H100 / B200 or our quantized MI300 variant.

Anya Patel: OK. So plan A: keep public press dates, but stagger SKU availability and be explicit about staged regions. Plan B: if vendors miss their window, we show H100/B200 as default and enable an "opt-in" for H200 when ready.

Alex (VendorRep): From vendor side — we can prioritize a limited batch for US-west for the first press window. We'll need a firm embargo on numbers until we confirm serials. Also we can provide hot-spare capacity from partner pools for the second window.

Jori (SI lead): For SI integrations: we need validated images. Are we planning a single marketplace image or per-hw image? If microcode/driver differs, we likely need image variants and test tags.

Li Zhang: Yes. Recommend image tags: rI-2026-05-h100, rI-2026-05-b200, rI-2026-05-h200-rc. Keep RC for H200 until kernel patch lands. Example snippet for tags:```IMAGE_TAGS=(rI-2026-05-h100 rI-2026-05-b200 rI-2026-05-h200-rc)```

Mike Chen: I'll add a cascade routing rule in the runtime: prefer requested SKU, fallback order (H200 -> H100 -> B200 -> MI300-quant). Can we define SLO degradation thresholds?

Anya Patel: Yes. Ops SLOs: target p95 latency change <= +30% for fallthrough; cost delta flagged to biz if > 2x. Add automatic traffic shedding if cost spikes.

Sofia Romero: For messaging: we should be explicit: "Staged availability — select regions & limited slots" + a checkbox for "notify me" for SLA alerts. Avoid phrasing like "full availability" for either press window.

Alex (VendorRep): We'll confirm early-bird serial list by EOD Friday. If we can, we'll earmark 50 nodes for your first-wave US-west region.

Li Zhang: Action item for engineering: create image variants and smoke test matrix. I'll open a ticket with test permutations (model sizes, batch sizes, seq len).

Mike Chen: Action: I'll draft runtime fallback policy PR by Wed and include metric tags so cost/latency are visible per-route.

Sofia Romero: Action: I'll update the comms calendar and prepare language for staged availability. Will coordinate embargo wording with legal.

Anya Patel: Great. I'll own cross-org signoff and the partner handshake. If Alex confirms 50 nodes, we target a controlled wave for 2026-05-12 (US-west only) and global ramp on 2026-06-02. If vendor slips, we default to H100/B200 messaging and call the second window a full ramp.

deploy-bot: Deployment reminder — marketplace image rI-2026-05-h100 pushed to staging at 2026-04-18T16:02:12Z.

Jori (SI lead): Noted. SI teams need cluster access for validation. Can we provide a sandbox with the RC image and hot-spare connection details?

Anya Patel: Yes — Li, can you spin a staging sandbox tagged "partner-sandbox-5112" and invite Jori + Alex?

Li Zhang: On it. ETA ~ 24 hours. I'll include a short runbook: how to flip routing and simulate fallback.

Sofia Romero: One more thing — press embargo windows require a single source of truth doc. I'll create a sheet with locked dates, regions, SKUs, and current confidence level (green/yellow/red).

Anya Patel: Perfect. We'll reconvene Friday for final go/no-go after vendor confirmation. Thanks team :thumbsup:
